# `python_worker_logs`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
python_worker_logs()
```

Returns a table of logs collected from Python workers.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not in the function registry yet |
| Group | `table_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (table function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments |  |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SET spark.sql.pyspark.worker.logging.enabled=true;
```

Result:

```text
spark.sql.pyspark.worker.logging.enabled	true
```

```sql
SELECT * FROM python_worker_logs();
```
